name: NAEP grade-8 math + reading composite

anchors.source: Grade-8 NAEP scale scores have historically sat in the 260–285 band on the national assessment. L=250 marks a clearly stressed level below any observed U.S. reading since the current scale; U=290 marks a strong ceiling above historical U.S. highs, consistent with top-performing OECD peer averages when crosswalked.
